title: Certificate Program Scholarships for Public Professionals
Where_are_these_courses_hosted: These hands-on, practice-based certificate programs are hosted on Coursera.org, and can be completed in fewer than six months.
lede: To advance our mission to improve lives by enabling public professionals to deliver more effective and equitable policies and services, InnovateUS, with support from Google.org, is providing full scholarships to public sector professionals to enroll in a Google Career Certificate program to expand the uptake of digital skills in the public sector.

Where_is_this_program_available: We are currently piloting this partnership, but plan to expand to over 15 states and 2,000 learners nationwide.
How_can_I_or_my_team_sign_up: Interested in learning more about how you or your team can sign up for a free Google Certification through InnovateUS? Sign up for our mailing list!
